title: 32-head DAgger twins on the test links, once: net2 on net1 v10 against neto2 on neto1 v3, 14 policies
description: The one test-link run of the 32-head twins: round 25's online DAgger recipe unchanged on estimators that add five composite heads (departure rate, available capacity, overload, BDP and the other flows' arrival rate) to the 27: net2 on net1 v10 reading the means (exp-net2-r27-v10-270, r27-means) and neto2 on neto1 v3 (exp-neto2-r28-v3-267) with the rule on neto1 v3 at u = 0.25 (r28-u0.25) or 0.375 (r28-u0.375) as teacher, training seeds 1 to 3. Each arm's iteration was chosen on the validation links at campaign seed 21 by its five-family mean over its training seeds (exp-dagger32-iter-val-273): r27-means after iteration 59 (+0.160 over its seeds 1 and 3, the only ones that reached it; seed 2 hit its training time budget after iteration 39), r28-u0.25 after iteration 19 (+0.149) and r28-u0.375 after iteration 19 (+0.121). r27-means after iteration 39 (+0.149 over all three seeds, +0.155 over seeds 1 and 3) also runs, as a three-seed check on the two-seed choice; it is not the chosen arm; experiments/dagger32-confirm-val.json checks them at campaign seeds 11 and 31. Every training seed of each arm runs here beside BBRv3 and, as reference lines only, the rules on net1 v10 at u = 0.25 (rule-v10), on neto1 v3 at u = 0.375 (rule-v3) and on net1 v9 at u = 0.25 (rule-v9, to tie this run to the 27-head twins' test runs exp-dagger-twins-test-258 and exp-dagger-twins-s456-test-272, whose links and campaigns these are): the five families (training seed 13, others 31), the held-out competitors (BBRv3 and Westwood) and 2 and 4 copies. Nothing is chosen or tuned on these links.
prepare: N10="$IN/v10/$(cat "$IN/v10/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; N3="$IN/v3/$(cat "$IN/v3/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; N9="$IN/v9/$(cat "$IN/v9/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v10" "$N10" --u 0.25; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v3" "$N3" --u 0.375; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v9" "$N9" --u 0.25; P=(--policy "rule-v10=$OUT/v10/rule-u0.25.onnx" --policy "rule-v3=$OUT/v3/rule-u0.375.onnx" --policy "rule-v9=$OUT/v9/rule-u0.25.onnx"); (cd "$IN/x" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); for f in "$IN"/x/ppo-r27-means-s*-i59.onnx "$IN"/x/ppo-r27-means-s*-i39.onnx "$IN"/x/ppo-r28-u0.25-s*-i19.onnx "$IN"/x/ppo-r28-u0.375-s*-i19.onnx; do n="$(basename "$f" .onnx)"; n="${n#ppo-}"; it="${n##*-}"; b="${n%-*}"; P+=(--policy "${b%-*}-$it-${b##*-}=$f"); done; [ "${#P[@]}" -eq 28 ]; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" test 13 31 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/heldout.py "$OUT/spec-held-competitors-60" --split test --family held-competitors --duration-ms 60000 --seed 31 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-held-competitors-60/campaign.json" "$OUT/c-held-competitors-60"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split test --duration-ms 30000 --seed 31 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart held-competitors-60 copies-30s && uv run python experiments/versus_rule.py "$OUT" rule-v10
